caveats.en: Applies to the portable nvidia_arm64 build. Comfy Desktop is listed as emulated. Custom nodes with x64 DLLs do not load.
caveats.zh-TW: 適用於可攜式 nvidia_arm64 版本。Comfy Desktop 被列為模擬執行，含 x64 DLL 的自訂節點無法載入。

evidence.title: ComfyUI releases (v0.44.0 latest; v0.40.0 added the ARM64 NVIDIA portable build)
